concurrent_tasks.label: make_a_calming_drink
concurrent_tasks.description: In the evening, prepare herbal tea, warm milk, or another caffeine-free drink. Pair it with your wind-down routine. [https://w3id.org/calendar-bench/health/task/make-a-calming-drink]
